Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: isolated game armor component input for image-to-3D, not a character concept sheet. Using Concept02/16.png as design authority, isolate the wearer's RIGHT shoulder cap: the large rigid deltoid plate on the image-left shoulder of the front figure. Render one complete cap in an outer-right three-quarter product view, top up, broad outside face and shallow curved edge thickness clearly readable. Preserve the source's restrained angular outline, clipped corners, broad faceted face, modest chamfers, dark gunmetal finish, subtle wear and visible recessed rim-fastener arrangement. The crown and bent side portions belong to one continuous shell, not overlapping extra plates. Complete only the occluded continuation as a simple shallow concave interior with modest wall thickness and an open body-facing side; do not make a solid lump or deep bowl. Supporting T-pose images establish placement only, not replacement design details. Center the entire object in a square image with ample white margin, pure opaque white background, neutral soft illumination and no ground or cast shadow. No body, sleeve, straps, torso harness, separate arm armor, extra objects, layered wings, text, labels, dimensions or collage. Do not enlarge into a fantasy pauldron or add decoration.
Output one square 1536 x 1536 image, highest available quality. Reference image 1 is the selected original character design. Extract only its wearer-right deltoid cap (screen-left on the front full-body figure). Keep its compact original proportions and large-plane construction.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Correct the isolated shoulder cap in image 1 to match the much shallower shoulder plate in reference image 2 (wearer's RIGHT shoulder, image-left on the front full-body figure). Keep its overall angular outer-face outline, top-up orientation, restrained bevels, gunmetal and rim fasteners. Change only the excessive wraparound depth: make this a shallow curved armor sheet over the deltoid, with modest bent crown and very short edge returns. Remove the long hanging inner/right return wall that currently turns it into a deep U-shaped bucket. The rear is open; no opposite side wall hanging as low as the front, no closed backing or deep bowl. Preserve a believable thin continuous shell and visible short edge thickness. Keep the outside broad plane dominant, with only a shallow lip visible behind it. Show the same outer three-quarter angle as image 1 so the reduced depth is immediately readable. No new decorations, anatomy, cloth, straps, additional parts, captions or collage. One complete object centered with white margins, pure opaque white background, soft neutral light, no ground shadow. Square image 1536x1536.
